name: replo
description: REPLO workout tracker — API and web client.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @replo/api" "npm run dev -w @replo/web"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n api,web,mcp -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @replo/api" "npm run dev -w @replo/web" "npm run dev -w @replo/mcp"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @replo/api" "npm run dev -w @replo/web -- --host"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n api,mcp -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @replo/api" "npm run dev -w @replo/mcp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @replo/shared && npm run build -w @replo/api && npm run build -w @replo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @replo/shared && npm run build -w @replo/api && npm run build -w @replo/web
